title: Utah mom speaks out after another parent allegedly kidnapped her child over bullying claims
summary: A Utah mother is speaking out, alleging the mom of one of her son's classmates grabbed him off the street last September. Shannon Tufuga is accused of kidnapping Amberlee Collazo's son, driving him to her home and forcing him to apologize to her child whom she claimed he bullied. Collazo spoke exclusively to CBS News about the incident.
